verdict.rationale: Online incorporation services could plausibly offer an API or programmatic submission, so this axis applies. However, the evidence only describes an interactive, human-authenticated web flow: Cartão de Cidadão or Chave Móvel Digital login, digital signatures by every partner, and manual payment. Nothing documents headless, CLI, API or CI-driven operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
